remarks: Welcome to the 'Darling of Silver Strand'--a reimagined 1940's coastal gem that serves as a total masterclass in high-design living. Just steps from the sand, this residence has been meticulously transformed by Claire Kramer Interior Design to offer a flawless blend of historic soul and elite modern infrastructure. It is a place where the nostalgia of the past meets a contemporary dream, offering a life of effortless beauty and quiet coastal magic. Inside, every corner invites you to linger. The interior ambiance is defined by light-drenched rooms featuring wide-plank DuChateau herringbone hardwood floors, imported English wallpapers, and bespoke crystal hardware.
